name: mghal-official-website
description: Bilingual M.GH.AL official static website — quality and TypeScript tooling

scripts.check:generated: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('dist/scripts/credentials.js','utf8');const b=fs.readFileSync('assets/credentials.js','utf8');if(a!==b){console.error('Generated browser script is stale. Rebuild and commit assets/credentials.js.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:scripts && npm run check:generated
scripts.quality: npm run build && npm run audit:html
